DESIGN-07.evidence: Gatekeeper review on 2026-10-26 of the working tree at HEAD 7ba264c. What holds: catalog.md (v1, 2026-10-25, md5 93bec4e55b23bcac86505bdfbc26dfc0) maps all 15 items to a vault motivation and a price tier (sections 2 and 4). My re-run of models/catalog_numbers.py is byte-identical to the stored output (md5 58aa71303473ff0996798dab5ad1c45d): a ladder of 49-699 Robux with 8 Impulse, 6 Core and 1 Premium item. Columns U1-U7 equal the vault's seven 'unfair' rows (vault/09-monetization/monetization-strategy.md lines 27-35). The D6 constraints (section 3.1), the D2 handling (section 6) and escalation E-0001 are in place, and the config proposal's flags match. What fails: the catalog has not been revised since economy sheet v2 (T-0015) and GDD v3 and v3.1 (T-0014, T-0017). As it stands, it contradicts them on the product definitions and figures its fairness rows rest on. (1) Coin products. Section 3.8 counts the 2x Coins pass in the coin-pack basis: 'permanent multipliers (Rod, companions, bonus, 2x Coins pass, New Tide)'. Its panel copy reads 'about M minutes of your fishing' (section 3.8 and the coin-packs row of section 8). Economy sheet v2 sections 3.1 and 19.2, and GDD v3.1 section 5, leave the 2x Coins pass out of every minutes-of-income grant, so that Robux never compounds on Robux. In model output B the heavy spender is 3.01x the casual player on goal 5, against 3.41x with the pass in the basis. Sheet section 19.2 also says the copy must read 'minutes of fishing'. So Coin Pouch, Starter Pack, Coin Crate and Coin Chest each have two definitions across the accepted documents. Under the sheet's basis, the catalog's copy overstates the minutes 2x for a pass owner, a misleading description (column U3). T-0015 'Next' asked for this change, and no task has made it. (2) Fairness evidence cites superseded numbers. Section 3.2 says '2.6-3.7x' and the section 5 2x Coins row says 'payers 2-4x faster (sheet section 1)'. Both describe the v1 placeholder payer; sheet v2 sections 1 and 19.1 give 1.31x, 2.34x and 2.87x. Section 3.4 and the section 5 Lucky Bobber row put Lure 7 at 'minute 23.9'; sheet v2 section 1 and my re-run (output B) give 23.7. (3) The three Sky Bell rows in section 5 still pass with 'watch W1, W2', and the watch note says 'At launch, the only natural fronts over Pebble Cove are Showers'. That has been false since GDD v3 section 4.2 rule 8 and world plan v2 section 7.1 added hourly Cove Fog and Cove Gusts (my re-run of specs/cove_visits_check.py: 0 of 168 hours missing a visit). Also stale, and not a reason for the fail: maxed payer luck x5.62 in section 3.4, against x5.63 in sheet section 10 (5.625, rounding only).
